_source: docs/BEST_TIMES_3PERDAY.md (decided 2026-10-24 from the owner's own analytics; owner: 'pick from analytics only'; next review 2026-11-03). Edit both together.
rule: Three reels per GST day. Reel N takes slot N on every platform (slots at least 3 h apart per platform). One carousel/post per day on Instagram and LinkedIn at the carousel slot, never on a reel slot. Friday: nothing 12:15-14:00 GST.

youtube.label: YouTube Shorts
youtube.how: Uploaded at queue time with privacyStatus private + publishAt = slot; YouTube makes it public itself.

linkedin.label: LinkedIn
linkedin.how: Posted by `app.publish_reel run-due --live` at the slot (the Mac must be awake).
linkedin.note: No own hourly data or read scope. 4 posts/day on one profile may cannibalise impressions; review 3 Nov.

instagram.label: Instagram Reels (Collab on @hammadagentic.ai + @with.hammad Trial Reel at the same slot)
instagram.how: Posted by `app.publish_reel run-due --live` at the slot (no API scheduling; the Mac must be awake); video and cover hosted on withhammad.com/media.
instagram.note: Own followers-online chart: 11:00 89 %, 14:00 89 %, 17:00 100 %, 20:00 92 %, 23:00 46 %. Backups = fixed-PST reading (+1 h).

tiktok.label: TikTok
tiktok.how: Scheduled with the composer's own Schedule option in the owner's Chrome (Asia/Dubai, so GST as written).

facebook.label: Facebook Reels
facebook.how: Scheduled with the composer's own Schedule option in the owner's Chrome (Asia/Dubai, so GST as written).

x.label: X
x.how: Scheduled at x.com/compose/post in the owner's Chrome (@HammadYousufAI, final_social.mp4, at most 280 weighted characters).
